top_signals.title: Copper Plunges Over 5% as AI Trade Unravels in Metals Markets
top_signals.summary: Copper plunged in a broad selloff across London, New York and Shanghai, as bullish investors bailed on bets tied to the AI boom and others turned outright bearish even as extreme squeezes roil metals markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Blackstone’s Jon Gray Calls Concerns About AI Bubble Overblown
top_signals.summary: Blackstone Inc. President Jon Gray reiterated his view that fears of a bubble in artificial intelligence are overblown and that AI infrastructure supply still lags far behind demand.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Credit Selloff Lures Bargain Hunters to ‘Stock Picker’s Market’
top_signals.summary: Credit has become a hunting ground for investors brave enough to swoop in on beaten-up securities.

top_signals.title: NYC Comptroller ‘Not Done Fighting Yet’ on Anthropic IPO
top_signals.summary: New York City Comptroller Mark Levine called it ‘disappointing” that Anthropic is moving ahead with its initial public offering this week despite calls for the company to pause the listing over AI safety concerns. He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
